item.title: have a seat
item.description: Take a seat. (请坐) Have a seat. (更随意) Please be seated. (更正式，如会议、典礼) Is this seat taken. （这个座位有人吗？）座位被占了了吗？ All seats are taken. I’m afraid we’re fully booked. (用于餐厅、酒店预订) The flight is full. (用于航班) It’s a full house. (用于剧院、体育馆，强调“座无虚席”的热闹场面) I’ll leave save a seat for you. (我给你留个位）。 I’ll save a seat for you. (用 save 比 leave 更主动，更显体贴，尤其在教室、会议中更常用) I’ve got a seat for you. (已经占好了，直接告知) It’s a hot performance, there’s no seat left.
